Jane Austen, Emma.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jane-austen/emma

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Jane Austen, the author, died 1817 (Wikidata Q36322); the gathered facts also record 1877 for the same person. Citizenship: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.

First publication of the text used: 1815 (SE colophon: 'Emma was published in 1815 by Jane Austen.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: works published before 1931 are in the public domain in the United States. The colophon dates this work to 1815. The edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the same.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died before 1926 (Jane Austen, in 1817 or 1877, both dates before 1926), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
